morbi.headline: Morbi faces severe export contraction alongside recurring domestic trade credit defaults and fraud.
what_changed: India's ceramic tile export volumes plunged 46% during April-July 2026, leading to a weak full-year FY27 export outlook.
Multiple buyer fraud incidents emerged, exposing manufacturers to unsecured trade credit defaults in the domestic market.
stress_signals: Export volumes dropped 46% year-on-year in Apr-Jul 2026, severely dampening the FY27 demand outlook for ceramic tile makers [434975bd08e0].
A Mumbai-based buyer allegedly defrauded a Morbi ceramic unit of Rs 44 lakh after procuring tiles on credit [e694c857f915].
A buyer absconded after securing 7,865 ceramic tile boxes on credit, reflecting recurring unsecured payment defaults in the cluster [76fdd3301f32].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export trajectory and subsequent export volume prints following the 46% drop in Apr-Jul 2026.
Elongation of debtor collection cycles and rising non-payment/fraud risks on unsecured domestic credit sales.
Working capital utilization and cash flow stress in export-focused tile manufacturing units facing volume drops.

surat.headline: Surat textiles face severe pre-Diwali shutdowns and labor unrest while diamond exports drop.
what_changed: Textile loom units face early closures and a month-long shutdown affecting 75,000 workers due to a 50% jump in raw material costs and a ₹50/kg yarn price hike.
Labor unrest escalated across weaving and embroidery units, leading to worker detentions, union friction, and reverse migration of migrant workers to UP and Bihar.
Diamond sector reported a 7% decline in polished exports alongside scrutiny over UK advertising rules for lab-grown diamonds, counterbalanced by domestic bridal demand for larger stones.
stress_signals: Severe input-cost shock prompting scheduled month-long loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6] and early pre-Diwali closures from a ₹50/kg yarn hike [b567711c9ed4].
Persistent three-month impasse in the embroidery sector coupled with labor protests, worker detentions, and staff departures [e7921383cbb7] [7697e96a190e] [af8a29b318b7].
Labor strikes prompting migrant worker exodus to UP and Bihar, alongside eight-hour power cuts disrupting continuous operations [d6a4b0e6a74b] [167f80ff6cdc].
Polished diamond export shipments contracted by 7% [975918f112f3], while payment defaults surfaced across diamond polishing (₹70,000) and grey fabric (₹29.57 lakh) [698c779932f2] [c4997bb35d98].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted relief via Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and reduced highway inspections for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Structural diversification efforts underway with cluster expansion into defence technical textiles [0f163b499572] and MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs generating ₹120 crore in businesses [7dc3005e0b28].
Domestic bridal demand shifting toward larger lab-grown diamond stones for the current wedding season [694aea903d0a].
what_to_watch: Borrower capacity utilization and cash flows across loom and embroidery units facing extended shutdowns and idle machine capacity.
Inventory holding and receivable cycles among grey fabric and diamond processing job-workers vulnerable to counterparty payment delays.
Logistics and labor normalisation, specifically parcel train outcomes via FOSTA and return of migrant labor post-strike.
